usage: A common noun for a keyboard instrument, especially in music lessons, band practice, or casual conversation.
Often refers to an electronic keyboard rather than an acoustic piano; if you mean a piano, people usually say 鋼琴.
Can be used as the object of verbs like 彈, 學, 買, and 玩 when talking about playing or choosing an instrument.
In everyday speech, it sounds natural and neutral; very common in school, music shops, and among beginners.
